default.shell:
---

{{ if and (ne .Vars.win22cis_system_role "domaincontroller") .Vars.win22cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win22cis_rule_1_2_3 }}
    {{ if ne .Vars.win22cis_system_role "domaincontroller" }}
file:
  win22cis_1_2_3_allowadministratorlockout:
    title: "1.2.3 | Ensure 'Allow Administrator account lockout' is set to 'Enabled' (MS only) | AllowAdministratorLockout"
    path: '{{ .Vars.win22cis_snapshot_dir }}\SystemAccess.AllowAdministratorLockout'
    exists: true
    contents:
      - '/^{{ .Vars.win22cis_allow_admin_account_lockout }}$/'
    skip: {{ if eq .Vars.win22cis_system_role "standalone" }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 1.2.3
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-7
        - AC-19
    {{ end }}
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

odvs.description: win22cis_allow_admin_account_lockout is the policy setting that determines whether the built-in Administrator account is subject to the following Account Lockout Policy settings. 1 = enabled or 0 = disabled
odvs.name: allow_admin_account_lockout

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.2.3 | PATCH | Ensure Allow Administrator account lockout is set to Enabled"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_1_2_3
    - not prelim_win22cis_is_domain_controller
    - not prelim_win22cis_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_1.2.3
    - patch
    - password
    - NIST800-171_3.1.8
    - NIST800-171_3.1.18
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-7
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-19
  community.windows.win_security_policy:
    section: System Access
    key: AllowAdministratorLockout
    value: "{{ win22cis_allow_admin_account_lockout }}"
